item.title: Decolonising Research in Transport Geography
item.content:encoded:
This special issue in the Journal of Transport Geography explores decolonial approaches to transport research, examining how transportation studies can address and challenge colonial legacies and power structures within academic scholarship and real-world mobility systems.

Appel publié par Journal of Transport Geography. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
